objective: Review the final fixes applied to Data Quality Profiler v0.1.0 addressing all remaining findings from the ChatGPT final review handoff.
summary: Applied all 3 final review findings using TDD on branch fix/data-quality-profiler-review-findings. All fixes verified with new tests (58/58 pass, up from 53/53). Key changes: (1) Added Bazaar discovery metadata to the x402 protected route using @x402/extensions/bazaar declareDiscoveryExtension — the 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED response now includes extensions.bazaar with POST input metadata (type, method, bodyType), (2) near_constant value-frequency keys now use recursive canonicalize(value) instead of String(value), so structurally distinct objects like {a:1,b:2} and {a:1,b:3} are correctly counted as separate values, (3) computeNumericStats and computeStringStats return empty objects for empty arrays, preventing NaN/Infinity in all-null field profiles.

fixes_applied.finding: Required Bazaar discovery metadata absent from protected route
fixes_applied.fix: Import declareDiscoveryExtension from @x402/extensions/bazaar. Create bazaarExtension with method=POST, bodyType=json, input description (format + records), and output example (schema_version, scoring_version, quality_score, dataset). Add extensions: bazaarExtension at route level (not inside accepts). The paymentMiddleware auto-registers bazaarResourceServerExtension via checkIfBazaarNeeded.
fixes_applied.tests_added: 1 test in test/x402-plugin.test.mjs: verifies decoded.extensions.bazaar exists, has info.input.type='http', info.input.method='POST', info.input.bodyType present, and no nested bazaar.bazaar

fixes_applied.finding: near_constant uses String(value) which collapses all objects to '[object Object]'
fixes_applied.fix: Changed deriveNearConstant to use canonicalize(item.value) instead of String(item.value) for value-frequency keys. canonicalize recursively sorts object keys and uses JSON.stringify, so {a:1,b:2} and {a:1,b:3} produce distinct keys while String() would produce identical '[object Object]'.
fixes_applied.tests_added: 2 tests in test/infer.test.mjs: (a) 11 {a:1,b:2} + 1 {a:1,b:3} → distinct_count=2, near_constant=false; (b) 18 numeric 1s + 2 string '1's → distinct_count=2, near_constant=false

fixes_applied.finding: All-null fields run non-applicable string/numeric stat math over empty arrays
fixes_applied.fix: Added early return in computeNumericStats and computeStringStats when values.length === 0, returning empty object. This prevents Math.min/max on empty arrays (Infinity/-Infinity) and division by zero (NaN).
fixes_applied.tests_added: 2 tests: (a) test/infer.test.mjs: all-null field → no min/max/mean/median/string_min_length/string_max_length/string_mean_length in output; (b) test/api.test.mjs: API-level all-null field → JSON contains neither 'NaN' nor 'Infinity'

test_evidence.smoke_tests: /health OK (200), /v1/profile JSON OK (200, score=100, scoring_version=1.0), /v1/profile CSV OK (200, score=100)
